subject: indigenous-language
general_outcomes: By the end of Senior School, the learner should be able to:
Express themselves confidently and appropriately in a variety of social contexts,
Apply the use of indigenous language in various communication situations,
Demonstrate ability to apply indigenous knowledge, culture and values in varied situations,
Comprehend information in different contexts in the indigenous language,
Read fluently and with comprehension in indigenous language,
Use indigenous language to legibly write ideas and opinions in different formats,
Enjoy communicating using a variety of cultural language strategies.
